mood.style_notes: Swirling, high-gloss textures with deep red and electric blue create a sense of intense, fluid motion.
mood.summary: The high contrast and deep, saturated colors suggest a dark theme with punchy, vibrant accents.

background.reason: This is the darkest color available, providing a deep, moody foundation that matches the dark theme. (selected as the dark background by luminance)

foreground.reason: This bright, electric blue offers the highest contrast against the dark background for clear text readability.

accent.reason: This vibrant red provides a striking pop of color that represents the intense warmth of the liquid marble texture.

visual_style.label: cyberpunk
visual_style.reason: The high-contrast, electric blue and deep red palette paired with liquid textures evokes a high-energy cyberpunk aesthetic.

typography.reason: A sharp, modern monospace font complements the high-tech, high-contrast feel.

geometry.reason: Floating elements with small radii allow the wallpaper's dynamic swirls to flow around the UI.

effects.reason: Glassmorphism effects mimic the glossy, liquid marble texture of the background.

visual_hierarchy.reason: High-contrast borders distinguish active elements using the electric blue accent against deep red tones.

aesthetic.design_rationale: The design leverages glassmorphism and floating panels to integrate the UI with the wallpaper's intense, swirling motion. By using the electric blue for highlights and deep reds for structure, the rice maintains the high-contrast, high-gloss energy of the liquid marble style.
